findings.value: A queer nightlife venue open since 2009, working as a club, bar, cafe, gallery and community space, with drag and cabaret shows.

evidence.quote: Dalston Superstore is East London’s queer nightlife institution.
Having first slid open it’s rainbow shutters in 2009
Functioning in equal parts as a debaucherous nightclub, bar, cafe, community space and gallery

findings.value: The venue describes itself as a queer nightlife institution that caters to London's LGBTQIA+ community and supports LGBTQ+ charities.

evidence.quote: the venue proudly caters to London’s diverse LGBTQIA+ community
Supporting and uplifting LGBTQ+ charities and organisations is central to who we are
Superstore is as much a music-forward club as it is a front-running drag and performance space.
We’ve played host to dance music heavy-hitters

findings.value: Club nights, drag and cabaret shows, karaoke, open decks, film screenings and a drag brunch at weekends.

evidence.quote: We’re open 7 days a week for lowlight cocktails & catchups, film screenings, karaoke, open decks, or our ever-expanding list of notorious club nights.
Our weekend Drag Brunch has gained cult-status

notes: The venue's own About page (modified 2026-10-14) was read in full and is the main source. One WebSearch found no press review that could be read: travelgay.com returned 403 and was not retried, and a gaytimes page had no mention of the venue. The Time Out listing is a 2025 event listing, not a review, and is not used. The access and drag brunch pages were not re-read this run.
